verdict.rationale: CoreWeave is a GPU cloud and managed-Kubernetes platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing for buyers to ask about and the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no official MCP server. It documents only adjacent programmatic surfaces: the CKS and Inference APIs, generated gRPC/Connect clients, a Terraform provider, kubeconfig access, and an llms.txt file. None of these count as an MCP server.
